title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Two parties agree to keep each other's confidential information private, e.g. before discussing a partnership.
body: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement is made on {effective_date} between {party_a} and {party_b}.
1. Purpose. The parties want to share information for the following purpose: {purpose}.
2. Confidential information. Any non-public business, technical or financial information shared by one party with the other, in any form, is confidential.
3. Obligations. Each party will use the other's confidential information only for the purpose above, will not disclose it to third parties, and will protect it with at least reasonable care.
4. Exceptions. These obligations do not apply to information that is public, was already known to the receiving party, or must be disclosed by law.
5. Term. These obligations last for {term_years} years from the effective date.
6. Governing law. This agreement is governed by the laws of {governing_law}.
